name: WPC Reviewvane – Review Reminder for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
Boost your store’s credibility and sales with WPC Review Reminder. This powerful plugin automates the process of collecting product reviews from your customers and rewards their loyalty with automated coupon codes.

Whether you want to send a simple reminder or build a full-fledged loyalty system based on feedback, WPC Review Reminder provides all the tools you need in one professional package.

Key Features

🚀 Quick Review Portal

Let customers leave reviews effortlessly with a streamlined portal. Support both a Dedicated Page and a Popup Modal, allowing users to submit their ratings and feedback without navigating away from their flow. Includes character limits and word blacklisting for moderation.

🎟️ Automated Coupon Rewards

Incentivize honest feedback by automatically generating unique coupon codes for customers who submit a review. You can customize coupon types (percentage, fixed cart, fixed product), set expiry dates, and restrict coupons to the customer’s email for single-use security.

🧠 Smart Product Selection

Don’t just ask for a review of everything. Choose the most relevant product from an order to maximize impact. Options include:
* First or Last product in order.
* Most Expensive or Cheapest product.
* Highest or Lowest average rating.
* Highest or Lowest quantity in order.

📊 Powerful & Detailed Statistics (Premium)

Track your success with a professional dashboard featuring visual charts for:
* Review Activity: See daily trends of emails sent, opened links, and submitted reviews.
* Coupon Utilization: Monitor issued vs. used coupons.
* Rating Distribution (stars): Get a clear overview of customer satisfaction levels.

📋 Comprehensive Reminders Queue

Keep full control over your automated emails with the Reminders Queue.
* Track the status of every reminder (Pending, Sent, Reviewed).
* Search and filter reminders by customer or order.
* Send manually if needed with the “Send Now” feature.

🛠️ Tools to Sync Orders

Already have orders? No problem. Use our built-in sync tool to scan all existing completed orders and add them to the reminder queue automatically, ensuring no customer is left without an invitation.

  • WPC Force Sells
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/reviewvane-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under the WPClever > Review Reminder menu.
